newsitem.title: USA: U.S. defense secretary to visit Europe.
newsitem.headline: U.S. defense secretary to visit Europe.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen will visit NATO headquarters in Brussels and will also go to Germany, Bosnia and Italy early next month on his first foreign trip, the Pentagon said on Friday.

Cohen, who became defence secretary last month, will go first to Brussels on March 3. He will meet U.S. troops in Bosnia and hold talks with the German and Italian defence ministers before flying home on March 7.

Cohen, a former senator from Maine and only Republican member of President Bill Clinton's Cabinet, will meet with the U.S. permanent representative to NATO and members of the American mission to the alliance in Brussels on Martch 4, then go to Bonn for talks with German Defence Minister Volker Ruehe.

He will visit U.S. troops at combat training areas in Germany, go to Tuzla in Bosnia to meet American forces and hold talks in Rome with Italian Defence Minister Beniamini Andreatta before flying home.

The United States has committed up to 8,500 troops as part of a NATO-led peacekeeping force in Bosnia and defence officials said Cohen wanted to visit with some of those troops as one of his first overseas tasks.
Cohen is also expected to meet with other NATO officials in Brussels at the start of his trip, although no firm schedule for his brief visit there was announced.
